# PaintSurface

**Class:** `UltraCanvasPaintSurface` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasPaintSurface.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasPaintSurface.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasPaintSurface.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

**Edit** a bitmap: layers, selection, brushes, zoom / pan with pixel grid (the model is `UCRasterDocument`, the brushes `UltraCanvasBrushEngine.h`)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPaintSurface> CreatePaintSurface(const std::string& id);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
explicit UltraCanvasPaintSurface(const std::string& elemId = "PaintSurface");
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onToolPress` | `std::function<void(const PaintPointerEvent&)> onToolPress` | _Tool press_ |
| `onToolDrag` | `std::function<void(const PaintPointerEvent&)> onToolDrag` | _Tool drag_ |
| `onToolRelease` | `std::function<void(const PaintPointerEvent&)> onToolRelease` | _Tool release_ |
| `onToolHover` | `std::function<void(const PaintPointerEvent&)> onToolHover` | move without a button |
| `onToolDoubleClick` | `std::function<void(const PaintPointerEvent&)> onToolDoubleClick` | _Tool double click_ |
| `onToolKey` | `std::function<bool(const UCEvent&)> onToolKey` | Keys reach the tool first (Escape cancels a marquee, Enter commits a crop); return true to consume. |
| `onDrawOverlay` | `std::function<void(IRenderContext*, const PaintViewTransform&)> onDrawOverlay` | Draw tool previews in VIEW coordinates after the image and selection. |
| `onViewChanged` | `std::function<void()> onViewChanged` | The view moved: a zoom, a pan, a resize, or a document change that kept the canvas in view (the status bar, overlays in view coordinates). |
| `onFilesDropped` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<std::string>&)> onFilesDropped` | Files dropped onto the surface. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### struct `PaintViewTransform`

Image <-> view mapping: view = origin + image * zoom (view coordinates are local to the element).

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `zoom` | `double zoom = 1.0` |  |
| `originX` | `double originX = 0.0` |  |
| `originY` | `double originY = 0.0` |  |

Methods: `ImageToView`, `ViewToImage`

### struct `PaintPointerEvent`

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | `double x = 0.0, y = 0.0` | image coordinates (sub-pixel) |
| `view` | `Point2Di view` | the same in element-local pixels |
| `button` | `UCMouseButton button = UCMouseButton::NoneButton` |  |
| `ctrl` | `bool ctrl = false, shift = false, alt = false` |  |
| `pressure` | `float pressure = 1.0f` |  |
| `insideImage` | `bool insideImage = false` | True when the pointer is over the canvas rectangle (tools may still want events outside it, e.g. a marquee dragged past the edge). |
